item.title: All the latest bugfixes
item.description:
What's fixed and changed

What's new in this version (42.2):

  • Fixes for "fullscreen disable" on Ventura
  • Fixes for "dim on disable" on Monterey and other OSes
  • Native support for Apple Silicon
  • Support for DCI-P3 wide-gamut displays. Previously, they looked a bit greenish and oversaturated, but now they look better than standard gamut displays.
  • Darkroom fix on M1/Apple Silicon

f.lux is supported by user contributions. We appreciate your help!
Click this link to send us $10 (or whatever you like). Thank you!

What's new in this version (39.987):

  • Fixed map popup when you change timezones (now you can tell it's f.lux)
  • Automatic updater fixes

What's new in this version (39.983):

  • Fixes for northern latitudes
  • Fixes for a startup crash
  • Better transitions around sunset and sunrise
  • A graph that shows your light sensitivity
  • Dark Theme is back!
  • Changing timezone prompts for a location change
  • Fixes darkroom on 10.12.4

What's new in this version (37.7):

  • Fixes a disable bug
  • A fix for f.lux staying active during the day on newer El Capitan builds

What's new in this version (37.2):

  • Battery use is optimized
  • Fixes for movie mode flashing
  • Support for more latitudes
  • New Sparkle updater, and a check for updates button

If you previously downloaded 37.1, this one has a small fix for automatic brightness.

What's new in 36.3:
  • Backwards alarm clock: tells you how much sleep you can still get if you go to bed now
  • Dim on disable: Less painful to check colors at night
  • Warmer options during the day
  • Tons of bugfixes
Read more about this update here.
